4:t_009:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...All units, retreat. We are abandoning this area.」

4:t_009:6.en:
$$アル$$
「A sound decision. Sergeant, fall back.」

4:t_009:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is that really the only option...?」

4:t_009:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You heard the order, all units. We will fall back and regroup.」

4:t_009:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Don't forget. This is not the end of the fight.」

4:t_010:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This... looks like it's going to turn into a serious problem...」

4:t_011:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Are the 《$$血塗られた眼$$》 really all right now!?」

4:t_011:4.en:
$n
「But right now, I have no choice but to do it!」

4:t_100:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$オズマ$$, at this rate...!」

4:t_100:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I know...! But even so, if we fall back...!」

4:t_100:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
(Sorry, $$ランカ$$... I may never see you again...)

4:t_101:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$アルト$$...! Enemies are coming from every direction!」

4:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll knock down every last one of them!」

4:t_101:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That's impossible! There are too many of them!」

4:t_101:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I know that! But I have to do it anyway!」

4:t_102:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Damn! I'm not happy that I don't even have to aim!」

4:t_102:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「Quit whining, $$ミシェル$$! If we don't do this, Earth will...!」

4:t_102:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I know! Today I'm going with barrage fire!」

4:t_103:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Get back, $$さやか$$! It's dangerous here!」

4:t_103:1.en:
$$さやか$$
「What are you saying, $$甲児$$! I'm a warrior who protects Earth too!」

4:t_103:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「Let's go, $$甲児$$! To protect everything that's precious to us!」

4:t_103:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Right! If it's come to this, we'll fight with everything we've got!」

4:t_104:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「R-$$竜馬$$, this is reckless! Let's fall back!」

4:t_104:4.en:
$$隼人$$
「If we pull back, all that's waiting for us there is hell.」

4:t_104:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go! We push forward and bust through this situation!」

4:t_105:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away... I mustn't run away...!」

4:t_105:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「We've done our best to protect Earth...! So... this time too...!」

4:t_106:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't push it, $$宗介$$! If you charge in carelessly, you'll get mobbed from all sides!」

4:t_106:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm leaving the interception of the enemies around us to you! I'm going up front!」

4:t_106:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch... no helping it! So we've got no choice but to do it, huh!」

4:t_106:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant, this tactic can only be described as reckless.」

4:t_106:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't need you to tell me that.」

4:t_106:5.en:
$$アル$$
「If you understand that, I have nothing to say. I will provide all the support I can.」

4:t_106:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Looks like you understand the situation too.」

4:t_106:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do this...! I'll shoot down as many enemy units as I can!」

4:t_106:8.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$ is aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ too...! I'll protect her, no matter what...!)

4:t_107:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We meant to watch the $$時の牢獄$$ collapse, and it turns out like this.」

4:t_107:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「It was supposed to be a joyous day, and it turns into Earth's worst day of all.」

4:t_107:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We're here to keep that from happening.」

4:t_107:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Roger that, $$ベン$$! Let's show them what Earth and the rest of us are made of!」

4:t_108:0.en:
$$ファ$$
「Fighting this many enemies in a situation like this...!」

4:t_108:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Focus, $$ファ$$! If you let your guard down for even a second, you're done for!」

4:t_108:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(The difference in numbers is too great...! At this rate, sooner or later...)

4:t_109:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn...! Damn! It's come to this...!」

4:t_109:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Lieutenant $$リディ$$! You have to focus on what's in front of you...!」

4:t_110:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「Ha ha... Wow... this is such a tight spot that all you can do is laugh.」

4:t_110:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Even you can't seem to muster your usual positivity, huh.」

4:t_110:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$マリ$$...! This is no time to be saying that...!」

4:t_110:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「I know, I know, Teach! If it's come to this, we just have to brazen it out!」

4:t_110:6.en:
$n
(《$$アドヴェント#keyword$$》... I'll create hope...!)

4:t_111:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Lieutenant $$キャシー$$... Send me the battle analysis data in real time.」

4:t_111:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(The situation is overwhelmingly against us... If we misjudge when to withdraw, we could be wiped out...)

4:t_112:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...! The difference in strength is overwhelming! If this becomes a war of attrition, our defeat is certain!」

4:t_112:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「I know that, and so do Captain $$ジェフリー$$ and the others!」

4:t_112:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「But even so, retreating is not allowed! Isn't that a soldier's duty!」

4:t_112:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「That said, I have no intention of sinking the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$!」

4:t_112:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「XO! Keep checking our ship's damage at all times! If necessary, we'll have to retreat!」

千鳥.evidence: Kaname Chidori; Sousuke calls her by surname (glossary 千鳥かなめ = Kaname Chidori, female)

碇.evidence: Rei addresses Shinji Ikari by surname (glossary 碇シンジ); Jigoku English used literal Ikari

ベン.evidence: Mao's nickname for Clouseau (Belfangan Clouseau; 'Ben' in Full Metal Panic)
